d:
The JRPG games crossover story that had to be done: the town of Guldove from Chrono Cross, built offshore upon stilted platforms in the El Nino Archipelago, being paid a visit by the massive sailing wooden japanese-inspired city of Suikoden V!

Steena, the wise ruler of Guldove, successor to the previous sage woman who died of elderly age, finish reading a letter received days earlier, the letter signed by Saileed, Queen Arshtat's sister and second in line for the throne of the Falena Queendom.

Steena cannot contain her own excitement for the upcoming arrival of Saileed in Guldove, which is going to be celebrated with the most memorable summernight parties ever for days to come!

Characters:

Arshtat - Queen of Falena (Suikoden V)
Saileeed - Arshtat's sister (Suikoden V)
Kisara - Raftfleet's helm woman with canonically MASSIVE TITS (Suikoden V)
Lin - Kisara's own daughter, very cute but flat chested (Suikoden V)
Steena - Guldove's ruler and overseer (Chrono Cross)
